Name: BlendShape
Description: This will create blendshapes for the selected geo

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create blendshapes for the selected geo.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetGeo: set the node/object name this block should use.
- NewNames: enter names separated by commas (example format: nameA,nameB,nameC).

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
